averaged_reference.interpretation: Least-damped oscillatory pole of the uncorrected averaged skeleton; not treated as a small frequency perturbation of the EMT dominant ring-down mode.

error_metrics.metric_distinction: Complex-eigenvalue error and damping-ratio error quantify different properties and must not be conflated.

baseline_mode_mismatch_note: The averaged reference pole (-5.2 ± j18.5 rad/s, about 2.94 Hz) and EMT/Prony pole (-15.30 ± j122.4 rad/s, about 19.48 Hz) are treated as a baseline mode mismatch. The uncorrected averaged skeleton omits or homogenizes PWM switching, dead-time, sampled-data effects, and the remaining EMT-to-envelope discrepancy; residual correction shifts the dominant branch close to EMT/Prony.
